headline: Superintendent search, including a national search, timeline, funding, and salary parameters.
summary: Updates include North Reading Transportation and the Year 3, Quarter 1 Strategy Plan. Other action items cover a staffing request, gifts and donations, and a Youth Center lease addendum.
items: MHS request to host an exchange student
Negotiation committee assignment: Unit B administrators
Negotiation committee assignment: Unit D secretaries
Superintendent search timeline review and approval
National search approval for the next Superintendent of Schools
Authorization and appropriation of funds for the national search, with a not-to-exceed amount and funding source
location: Media Center, Methuen High School, 1 Ranger Road, Methuen, MA
